cancellation.meaning: bounded compiler work between polls; no promise of fixed wall-time latency in a blocking allocator or host syscall

count_ceiling_scope: all stored function slots/entries, including terminators and un-compacted dead slots; limits are independent ceilings and need not all fit simultaneously in the byte/work limits

counter_api.effect: admit prospective live capacity and traffic against all ancestor budgets before allocation; include old/new overlap; track pending reservations separately
counter_api.name: reserveCapacity

counter_api.effect: convert pending reservation into live capacity and successful allocation traffic
counter_api.name: commitReservation

counter_api.effect: undo failed pending reservation; no successful allocation traffic is added and work already consumed is not undone
counter_api.name: cancelReservation

counter_api.effect: drop live ownership only after the backing storage is released or exclusively transferred; traffic never decreases
counter_api.name: releaseCapacity

counter_api.effect: admit destination branch before atomic ownership transfer; common-ancestor capacity is unchanged and transfer adds no fresh allocation traffic
counter_api.name: transferCapacity

counter_api.effect: admit a bounded work batch before execution; no per-visit allocation or virtual dispatch
counter_api.name: chargeWork

counter_api.effect: stop unfinished attempt; no partial/stale-ready publication
counter_api.name: pollCancellation

counter_api.effect: capture committed live/peak, pending/reserved peak, successful traffic, visit usage, unused prepaid credits and exhausted-limit identity
counter_api.name: snapshotCounters

failure.budget_exhaustion: structured compiler resource-limit outcome, not a source type error or generated-program trap
failure.counters: checked wide arithmetic; compare products against quota with division before multiplication when required
failure.fallback: no silent mutable-register fallback and no bypass of verification
failure.invalid_input: structural/type failures remain invalid-IR outcomes; exceeded valid admission limits are resource-limit outcomes
failure.overrides: explicit internal request-profile values, recorded before execution; no new source syntax or CLI flag is selected
failure.publication: failed/cancelled attempt produces no ready UIR, verifier stamp, or committed artifact
failure.retry: function attempts are fresh; request-level consumed work/traffic survive retries; no automatic retry with enlarged quotas or cached ready result from failure

excluded_but_reported: source snapshots and AST/semantic state owned by earlier stages
allocator reserved/free-pool bytes not owned by UIR
runtime GC retention and process/interpreter overhead
memory.fresh_allocation_traffic: sum of successfully acquired backing capacity; reserve prospective traffic before allocation and commit it only on success; growth charges the full new allocation; reuse is not a fresh allocation; traffic never decreases
memory.ownership_assignment: function records/pools/scratch must be charged to their function owner; shared metadata is genuinely shared type/signature/constant/location data; moving function storage to shared ownership cannot evade its qualification gate
memory.qualification_scope: one function lifecycle: construction, promotion, and eight complete verifier calls; account all coexisting buffers and reuse scratch explicitly
memory.unit: bytes of owned backing capacity, including owned metadata and overlapping old/new allocations; allocator/runtime overhead reported separately unless charged by backing allocator

qualification.canonical_count_checkpoint: after promotion and trivial-parameter cleanup; before optional constant/CFG transformations
qualification.comparative_timing: informational for U1a; no 5-percent or other historical-median speed gate; same-host paired matched work and unchanged settings required for any comparison
qualification.float_and_malformed_ir_correctness: required before U1a acceptance; not established by U0 integer fixture timings
qualification.ordinary_verification_scope: construction validation and canonical verification remain mandatory; eight verifier calls are the explicit stress workload, not an added production pipeline requirement
qualification.pairing: five fresh-process baseline/candidate pairs per matched profile; reverse order between pairs; serialize benchmark jobs

scope: UIR compiler-owned state only; no change to the current production compiler, source semantics, or public CLI.
status: Selected initial engineering policy on 2026-10-29 under instruction to finalize U1a budgets; not candidate-validated or a measured optimum.

work.all_limits_apply: A phase must satisfy its global visit limit, its applicable component formula limits, byte limits, and count ceilings; satisfying one does not waive another.
work.promotion_frontier_entry_visits_formula: C*D; D is the once-built CFG dominance-frontier entry count
work.structural_formula: 32*(R+1), where R includes every encoded record, attribute, operand, result, edge argument, case and origin link checked in that verification scope
work.unit: one entry visit/comparison/hash probe; bulk data charge ceil(bytes/64); exact consumption and prepaid unused credits reported separately
